column2: Oh my, wait just a moment, all of you!
You're the ones who defeated $$グザファン$$, aren't you?
What?
Where did you learn that?
As the $$領主$$ of this city, there is nothing here I do not know!
So what does a love-addled $$領主$$ like you want?
Why, what a wonderful compliment!
It's about $$グザファン$$. He used his private army...
to kill men one after another, so he could make this city his alone.
Thanks to you, his threat is gone.
By way of reward, I shall grant you the right to live in this city forever...
In other words, from every woman in this city,
you may live with boundless lust offered to you...
You may speak of forbidden $$愛$$ with a different woman every day!
Th-that isn't $$愛$$!
Forbidden or whatever—you're only playing with the word $$愛$$!
The man standing here...
lost the one he $$愛$$d most simply for speaking of that $$愛$$...
He was wounded and put in prison,
and even after losing his own $$羽$$, he strives to uphold that $$愛$$...
Can any of you do the same?!
You... know $$愛$$ too, don't you?
I knew it.
That the $$愛$$ we speak of in the $$大邪神$$ legend...
is not true $$愛$$.
But we had no other choice.
To protect this city, we needed a bond to hold back the men leaving for the outside $$世界$$...
To keep you here, I knowingly used the word $$愛$$ even though I knew it was a $$罪$$.
Hmm. You knew speaking of $$愛$$ was a $$罪$$, and still you did it.
Then your desire and passion must run that deep.
At least, let me offer you my thanks.
Let me give you a lead on what you seek...
What? Could it be?
The $$総本山$$ of the $$アンゲルス教団$$...
is said to lie beyond $$ソドムとゴモラ$$, near the $$悪魔の海峡$$...
You guys aren't about to swallow another story like this whole, are you?
Where is my $$ご主人様$$?!
Where is the last armor?!
I want another ally!!!
I don't know anyone like that...
If the saying that armor calls armor is true,
one will eventually appear before you.
$$タルシス$$, then—what do you say...?
Yes, if I will do...
$$タルシス$$ joined the party!
See you. Once everything is over, we may come back to this city.
May I come back too...?
I will gladly await you!
If I find any strong people somewhere, I'll tell them about this place.
Yes, thank you.
By the way, young lady,
can you truly say you only $$欲情$$ after that person...? Hee hee.
Then shall we go, $$ルピルピ$$.
Y-yes!!
After she said that... you know!
